rationale: The agent's candidate patch introduces a type mismatch between the upgraded source code and the unmodified test files. In tofu/tofu.go, the Target field was changed from cli.StringSlice to []string, but the test file tofu/tofu_test.go still assigns cli.StringSlice values to it, causing a compilation error. Similarly, the agent's AppWrapper workaround for plugin_test.go failed because the test file was modified by the verifier's test patch to call Run with a context, which conflicts with the agent's Run([]string) signature. These are concrete compiler/type inconsistencies that prevent the tests from building.

evidence.quote: tofu/tofu_test.go:269:14: cannot use []string{…} (value of type []string) as cli.StringSlice value in struct literal
plugin/plugin_test.go:17:31: too many arguments in call to got.App.Run
